stages.validation: Fresh apply reaches schema v5 and a repeated apply is a no-op.
stages.decisionPoint: Stop before deploy if schema compatibility or idempotence fails.

stages.validation: Old code fails closed on incompatible schema; rollback creates a new immutable checkpoint.
stages.decisionPoint: Code rollback is allowed only across an additive compatible schema; otherwise roll forward.

stages.validation: Encrypted backup verifies and restore accepts only a new isolated database with matching rows and hashes.
stages.decisionPoint: Never switch a binding until schema, row, hash, read, and denied-write probes pass.

stages.validation: Repair is dry-run first, confirmation-bound, resumable, audited, and preserves the latest readable version.
stages.decisionPoint: Freeze writes and escalate if a committed object cannot be restored to its recorded hash.

stages.validation: Active, grace, revoked, recovery, atomic local persistence, and raw-secret redaction paths pass.
stages.decisionPoint: Revoke immediately after exposure; use owner recovery only when every capability is lost.
